name: ECA Maestro
description: Integrate ECA with the Maestro workflow module: adds ECA action and condition plugins that drive Maestro processes, tasks and process variables from ECA models.
project_description: ECA Maestro bridges the ECA (Events, Conditions, Actions) rules engine to the Maestro business-process/workflow module. It ships eight ECA action plugins and one ECA condition plugin (no events, routes, permissions, services, config objects or submodules of its own). The actions can launch a new Maestro process from a template, complete a task, set a task status, reassign a production assignment to a user or role, get and set Maestro process variables, resolve a process ID from a queue ID, and read a queue ID from the current request query. The condition checks whether a given user may execute a given task. All plugins wrap static methods on Drupal\maestro\Engine\MaestroEngine and resolve their configured values through ECA's token service, so their fields support tokens. Requires the ECA and Maestro projects (maestro is a Composer requirement; eca and eca_endpoint are the declared module dependencies).
